description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyFeature class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constraints on feature size.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyFeature, covering immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and size constraints.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ModifyFeature instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods work as expected for ModifyFeature.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeature
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyFeature with a null feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON representation of a ModifyFeature instance matches the expected structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a ModifyFeature object from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeFeatures
methods.description: Verifies that creating a feature exceeding size limits throws a ThingTooLargeException.
